title: Sampling Technique for Microorganism Communities in Crab Processing Plants
author: Abdullah, Nurhayati, et al.

steps.title: Sterilize equipment and prepare PBS
steps.instruction: Autoclave all reusable items (micro‑centrifuge tubes, tweezers, Schott bottles, PBS media) at 121 °C for 15 min; prepare PBS by dissolving 1 PBS tablet in 100 mL distilled water, dispense 40 mL into each 50 mL centrifuge tube and sterilize again.

steps.title: Determine sampling points and methods
steps.instruction: Consult the production flow schematic and Table 1 to select each sampling location and the corresponding tool (sterile cloth or cotton swab, medium (M) or jumbo (J)) and note the prescribed sampling area (e.g., 16 × 40 cm for cloth, 2 × 5 cm or 3 × 15 cm for swabs).

steps.title: Prepare sterile cloth for sampling
steps.instruction: Remove a sterile cloth from its dry plastic package, moisten it with PBS, place it on a sterile plastic Petri dish using tweezers, and add enough PBS to fully wet the cloth.

steps.title: Sample surface with sterile cloth
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, lay the wet cloth on the target surface, unfold it to a 16 × 16 cm width (maximum) and wipe slowly over a 16 × 40 cm area; then transfer the used cloth into a 250 mL Schott bottle, add 50 mL PBS, and manually shake to homogenize.

steps.title: Prepare sterile cotton swabs
steps.instruction: Open a sterile cotton‑swab package, dip each swab (medium M or jumbo J as required) into PBS to moisten it before use.

steps.title: Sample surface with sterile swabs
steps.instruction: Gently wipe the designated area with the moistened swab, then place the swab into a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 40 mL PBS (one tube can hold 4–5 medium‑size swabs); vortex the tube to homogenize and discard the swab, retaining the PBS eluate.

steps.title: Combine cloth and swab eluates
steps.instruction: Merge the PBS from the cotton‑swab tubes with the PBS‑cloth mixture in the Schott bottle, invert the bottle several times to homogenize, and remove the cloth pieces; keep the combined PBS solution for downstream inoculation.

steps.title: Inoculate TSB broth and incubate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 9 mL Tryptic Soy Broth (TSB) into each of five sterile tubes, add 1 mL of the combined PBS solution to each tube using a 1000 µL micropipette, then incubate at 35 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Harvest bacterial pellets by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the five incubated TSB tubes at 2400 g for 20 min at 10 °C; discard the supernatant and retain the bacterial pellet, transferring each pellet into a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube with a micropipette.

steps.title: Extract genomic DNA from pellets
steps.instruction: Use the Presto™ Mini gDNA Bacteria kit (Geneaid Biotech) for bacterial pellets and the DNeasy Blood & Tissue Kit (Qiagen) for eukaryotic/fungal pellets, following each manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality and quantity
steps.instruction: Run extracted DNA on agarose‑gel electrophoresis and/or analyse with the Agilent 5400 Fragment Analyzer to verify integrity and concentration.

steps.title: Amplify target rRNA regions
steps.instruction: Perform PCR amplification of bacterial 16S rRNA V3‑V4 regions and eukaryotic/fungal 18S rRNA V4 region using appropriate primers; the resulting amplicons are ready for metagenomic or sequencing analysis.
